title: Ext vanishing over a regular local ring
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] and $d=\dim R$ its Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Then $\operatorname{Ext}^q_R(M,N)=0$ [def-pc-ext] for every finitely generated $R$-module $M$, every $R$-module $N$ and every integer $q>d$.
